land.saleRestrictionsTitle: Not everyone can buy agricultural land in Maharashtra
land.restrictionAgriculturist: Under s.63 of the Bombay Tenancy Act, only someone already holding agricultural land anywhere in India may buy it. Everyone else needs the Collector's permission first.
land.restrictionTribal: Land held by a tribal owner cannot be sold to a non-tribal buyer without the Collector's sanction, and such a sale is void without it.
land.restrictionCeiling: Holdings above the ceiling limit set by the Agricultural Land (Ceiling on Holdings) Act cannot be bought, however willing both sides are.
land.restrictionFragmentation: The Fragmentation Act bars splitting a survey number below the standard area for the district, so part-parcels often cannot be registered.
land.tenancyRiskTitle: Letting farm land can create rights you cannot end
land.tenancyRiskBody: A cultivator in continuous possession can become a protected tenant under the Bombay Tenancy Act, with a statutory right to buy the land at a price the Tribunal sets. Use a written agreement that names the term and the purpose, and take advice before handing over possession.

err.commercialType: Select the type of commercial space.
err.shellType: Select the fit-out status — it sets the rent, and it is the first thing every enquiry filters on.
err.naOrder: Upload the NA order — you have stated the conversion is sanctioned, and it is the only proof of that.
err.naStatus: State whether the land has been converted to non-agricultural use — it decides what a buyer can build, and how long it takes them.
err.otherRights: State what the 7/12's Other Rights column carries. A charge or a tenancy survives the sale, so a buyer must know before they pay a token.
err.buyerEligibility: State who can lawfully buy this land. A non-agriculturist needs the Collector's permission, and an enquiry that learns this late is an enquiry you lose.

err.priceMin: A sale price starts at ₹1,00,000. Enter the full amount, e.g. 85,00,000 for 85 lakh.

editPolicy.offSearchNote: These change what the property fundamentally is, so your listing comes off search while we re-check it — usually within 24 hours.
editPolicy.staysLiveNote: Your listing stays live and searchable while we re-check these — buyers can still find it and contact you.

modal.identityBodyPost: , which makes this a different property rather than an update to your existing one. Keep your current listing as it is and post this one separately.
modal.dupBodyPost: — we matched it by its address and electricity meter. Publishing it again would create a duplicate, which hurts your reach and buyer trust. Edit or renew your existing listing instead of posting a new one.
